verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments (CDP) is a payments API and SDK platform, not an AI agent or host application, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only server-side MCP offerings (`cdp mcp` and the Coinbase Wallet MCP), which serve tools to other agents. That server-side evidence does not transfer to the MCP-client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
